name: Bloomridge Market
description: A terraced bazaar climbing the slope just inside the old walls, where awnings of patched sailcloth shade stalls of river-fish, cut flowers, and salvaged charms. Since the crisis the market has swollen with refugees hawking whatever they carried out of the ruin, and the city watch keeps a wary post by the cistern at its center. At dusk the lamplighters work their way up the steps and the haggling gives way to quieter trade.
